method: Only declarative SVG path geometry, stroke/fill attributes and per-control pose diffs. Pure render evaluated with inert JSX/color/clamp stubs, no Steam runtime or native transport.
license: Valve Steam client proprietary resources. Local prototype provenance; not an open-source/MIT claim.
rearSlots: PS5/Xbox add four visual rear slots using the original SteamDeckTiltedOutline rear fill/outline paths with group translations/scales. Original front geometry remains unchanged. Native catalog backIndex 1..4 governs availability; these are not a claim that every physical controller has four paddles.
